_comment: Table-driven client tests (v3). Verdicts: UpToDate | Offer:<v> | Required:<v> | Skipped:<v> | Snoozed:<v> | Ignore:<reason>. A run's `expect` is a verdict string for the whole manifest, or {desktop, android}. Run fields default to `defaults`. See README.md.
checkOrder: size, strict JSON profile (UTF-8, no BOM, depth<=32, no duplicate keys, no NaN, no lone surrogate), envelope keys exactly v/kid/payload/sig and v==1, kid (case-sensitive), canonical base64url, signature (S<L), payload strict JSON, schemaVersion (int; <1 parse; >1 schema), issuedAt/expires i64 ints (parse), issuedAt<=now+3600 (expired), 0<expires-issuedAt<=22d (expired), now<=expires (expired), issuedAt>=lastSeenIssuedAt (replay)

cases.description: Beta offer 0.3.0 -> 0.4.0 (Android versionCode 20400), rollout 100.
issuedAt == lastSeenIssuedAt is accepted.
issuedAt one second older than the last seen one.
Offered version equals installed.
beta 0.5.0, stable 0.4.0: the beta channel offers the beta entry.
beta 0.4.0, stable 1.0.0: beta falls back to stable only when stable is newer.
Signed with the next key test2 (kid test2): must verify.
minSupported 0.4.0 above installed 0.3.0 (rollout 25: Required and manual ignore partial rollouts).

cases.description: Required but rollout 0: a PAUSE is a hard stop, even for Required and manual checks.
rollout 0 for both components; offered iff bucket < 0 (bucket == rollout is NOT offered); 0 = pause.
rollout 50 for both components; offered iff bucket < 50 (bucket == rollout is NOT offered); 0 = pause.
rollout 100 for both components; offered iff bucket < 100 (bucket == rollout is NOT offered); 0 = pause.
expires < now.
now == expires is still valid (reject only now > expires).
issuedAt = now + 3600 s is accepted (tolerance 1 h).
issuedAt = now + 3601 s: clock-skew guard (reported as expired).
issuedAt now+30 after a client accepted issuedAt now+3600 at `now`: the ratchet stores min(issuedAt, now), so this is NOT a replay.
issuedAt older than the last seen one (rollback of the manifest).
A newer manifest that names an older version: never offered.
expires < issuedAt.
expires - issuedAt = 22 d + 1 s.
expires - issuedAt = 22 d is accepted.
schemaVersion 2, correctly signed: never half-parsed.
schemaVersion 2 AND a string issuedAt: the schema check comes first.
schemaVersion 0.
schemaVersion 1.5 (a fraction: whole payload is a parse error).
Signed JSON without issuedAt/expires.
issuedAt = 1795000000.0: a fraction is outside the number grammar.
issuedAt = '1795000000': wrong type.
issuedAt = True: wrong type.
issuedAt = 9223372036854775808: above the i64 range.
issuedAt = -1: a sign is outside the number grammar.
Valid envelope whose payload was replaced after signing.
One bit of the signature flipped.
63-byte signature.
payload is not base64url.
Signature text with non-zero trailing bits: same bytes under a lenient decoder, must be rejected.
Payload text with non-zero trailing bits (signature is valid for the decoded bytes).
Signature with '=' padding.
Malleable signature (R, S + L): verifies under a lax verifier, must be rejected (S >= L).
kid k9 is not in keys.json.
kid TEST1 (kid is case-sensitive).
Signed with test2 but labelled test1.
Envelope v = 2.
Envelope v = true.
Envelope keys must be EXACTLY v, kid, payload, sig: an extra key is rejected (not ignored).
Envelope without sig.
Duplicate key `kid` (the second names a valid key).
UTF-8 BOM before the envelope.
The envelope encoded as UTF-16.
Body is not JSON.
Body nested 32000 deep (fits in 64 KiB): rejected without recursing.
A valid manifest padded with trailing whitespace to exactly 65536 bytes: accepted.
The same, 65537 bytes: rejected before parsing.
Correctly signed but the body is > 64 KiB: rejected before any parsing.
Signature valid but the payload is not JSON.
Signed payload with an invalid UTF-8 byte.
Signed payload starting with a UTF-8 BOM.
Signed payload with a duplicate key.
Signed payload with NaN as issuedAt.
rollout is NaN: the whole payload is rejected by the strict profile.
A note title containing the lone surrogate escape \ud800.
A signed payload with a 20000-deep array.
Trailing comma in the object.
A /* comment */ in the JSON.
issuedAt 01795000000 (leading zero).
issuedAt +1795000000.
rollout .5.
Single-quoted string.
Unquoted key.
Garbage before the JSON.
Garbage after the JSON.
Trailing JSON whitespace (space, tab, CR, LF) is fine.
Payload nested exactly 32 deep (the root object is depth 1, arrays and objects both count): accepted.
Payload nested 33 deep: rejected.
Objects and arrays mixed, 32 deep: accepted.
Objects and arrays mixed, 33 deep: rejected.
Trailing comma in the envelope.
Unknown kid AND a non-string payload: the kid lookup comes first, so the reason is `signature` (never `parse`).
Known kid, payload is a number: `signature` (the shape check only requires the four keys and a string kid).
Known kid, sig is null: `signature`.
kid is a number: `parse` (the envelope shape is wrong before any lookup).
Envelope v = 1.0.
Envelope v = 1e0.
Envelope v = "1".
Duplicate key through an escape: "kid" and "k\u0069d" (the second names a valid key).
A duplicate key inside a component object.
A duplicate through an escape ("version" and "vers\u0069on") in a component.
The payload text contains both '-' and '_' (the base64url characters that differ from standard base64): accepted.
The same payload text with '+' and '/' instead of '-' and '_': rejected.
sig is the empty string.
payload is the empty string (openssl cannot sign zero bytes, so the signature is another message's): rejected as a signature failure, the empty bytes are never parsed first.
channels is {}: nothing to offer.
beta is null.
Offered 0.2.0 / code 20200 below installed.
Android entry named 0.4.0 but versionCode 20100 < installed 20300: not offered; desktop is.
Android name 0.2.9 but versionCode 20400: the code decides (Offer, shown as 0.2.9).
Android name equals the installed name (0.3.0) but versionCode 20400: Offer.
Only the desktop component is present.
rollout -1: a sign is outside the integer grammar.
rollout -0.
rollout 50.5.
rollout 100.0.
rollout 5e1.
rollout 1e999 (explicit parse error, never an infinity).
rollout 101. The component is DROPPED; the other one is still offered.
rollout "50". The component is DROPPED; the other one is still offered.
rollout true. The component is DROPPED; the other one is still offered.
rollout null (null is INVALID, not absent). The component is DROPPED; the other one is still offered.
minSupported null (null is INVALID, not absent). The component is DROPPED; the other one is still offered.
version 0.04.0. The component is DROPPED; the other one is still offered.
version 0.4.0+1. The component is DROPPED; the other one is still offered.
version 0.4.0-beta. The component is DROPPED; the other one is still offered.
version 0.4.0.1. The component is DROPPED; the other one is still offered.
version 99999999999.0.0 (parts must be <= 2^31-1). The component is DROPPED; the other one is still offered.
version 2147483648.0.0 (2^31). The component is DROPPED; the other one is still offered.
version with Arabic-Indic digits. The component is DROPPED; the other one is still offered.
minSupported 0.5.0 > version 0.4.0 (rule: invalid, so never a Required verdict). The component is DROPPED; the other one is still offered.
minSupported 'x'. The component is DROPPED; the other one is still offered.
version 2147483647.0.0 (the largest part) is accepted.
0.10.0 vs 0.9.0: parts compare as numbers, never as text.
versionCode 2^31. The component is DROPPED; the other one is still offered.
versionCode "20400". The component is DROPPED; the other one is still offered.
versionCode -1: a sign is outside the integer grammar.
Android entry without versionCode. The component is DROPPED; the other one is still offered.
versionCode 2100000000 is accepted, 2100000001 is not (see versionCode-above-max).
versionCode 2100000001. The component is DROPPED; the other one is still offered.
Unknown fields at the top level, in channels (an unknown channel), components, notes and downloads are IGNORED (no deny_unknown_fields). The ENVELOPE is the opposite: exact keys.

cases.description: Unicode, quotes, backslash, RTL letters (no format controls), empty detail, unknown, missing or NON-STRING glyph: shown verbatim; glyph falls back to star.
Titles/details containing < > & are dropped (the whole note).
U+202E / U+2066 bidi controls: the note is dropped.
A NUL character: the note is dropped.
Zero-width space, ZWJ and BOM characters: the note is dropped.
A newline or tab in a note: dropped.
One note per frozen rejected code point (title 'a<cp>b'): every one is dropped, only the good note remains. The list is in README.md.
Assigned/unassigned code points just outside the rejected set are ALLOWED (title 'a<cp>b'): U+2065 (unassigned between two Cf ranges), U+200A, U+2010, U+E0000, U+FFFE, U+1F600, U+00A0, U+3000.
More neighbours of the rejected ranges that are ALLOWED: U+00AC, U+00AE, U+E0002, U+180D, U+205F, U+2070, U+13441, U+1D172.
Scalars, not graphemes: 20 x 'e'+U+0301 is 40 scalars (kept), one more scalar is 41 (dropped); a ZWJ emoji sequence is dropped (ZWJ is rejected).
Lengths count Unicode scalars: 40 emoji (4 UTF-8 bytes, 2 UTF-16 units each) fit, 41 do not.
9 valid notes: the first 8 are kept.
A 41-scalar title: the note is dropped.
An 81-scalar detail: the note is dropped.
notes is a string: treated as no notes.
Non-object entries are skipped.
No notes at all: still an offer.
